newsitem.title: FRANCE: France may freeze 12 bln Ffr spending - source.
newsitem.headline: France may freeze 12 bln Ffr spending - source.

text.p: France's recently elected Socialist government may freeze budgeted spending lines worth 12 billion francs to fund new measures, a finance ministry source said on Wednesday.
"There will be spending lines which are unblocked, and others which will be frozen," the source told reporters.

The previous conservative government had frozen 10 billion francs in credit lines but the new Socialist government has said that it may make different savings from those of the outgoing administration.
There would be around 12 billion francs in additional spending and 12 billion in savings, the source said.
The government has said it does not intend to take any measures which will worsen the budget deficit.
It has said it plans a series of new measures to boost growth and jobs.
